brand.name: Eclipse
brand.positioning: A curated luxury marketplace: the breadth and autonomous curation of the mega-retailers, the polish and price confidence of the luxury houses, the edge of streetwear — kept clean, dark, and deliberate.

products.title: Obsidian Chain Belt
products.subtitle: Antiqued brass
products.description: Obsidian Chain Belt — built for those who already know. Antiqued brass with hand-linked chain. Dark, deliberate, and made to outlast the trend cycle. Specificity over volume, always.
bulletBenefits: Antiqued brass — quality you register before any logo
Hand-linked chain — the detail most of the market skips
Considered accessory silhouette — engineered to be worn, not just seen
Made in Portugal in a controlled run — no oversupply, no markdowns
emotionalHooks: Not for everyone. Exactly as intended.
